verdict.rationale: Check documents its own report generation: embedded Components can 'generate reports', and the MCP server can generate reports via natural language. Nothing in the evidence names payroll registers or gross-to-net reports specifically, or documents exporting them for analysis. missing for 10: explicit payroll register report, gross-to-net report documentation, documented export formats (CSV/XLSX) for payroll reports, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can generate payroll registers and gross-to-net reports and export them for analysis
